summary: A Yes vote authorizes the district to issue up to $129,630,000 in general obligation bonds for college facilities, classrooms, and equipment, repaid by an ad valorem property tax estimated at $7.76 per $100,000 of assessed value.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes a $129 million bond to fund expansions, remodels, and upgrades at Shasta College without increasing the property-tax rate for Shasta College bonds.
tax.quote: will expand and remodel college facilities through a series of capital projects and upgrades.

schools.text: A Yes vote funds facility improvements and educational programs at the public Shasta College district.
schools.quote: Bond Measure C will modernize 60-year-old buildings and facilities while expanding the college's ability to support public safety services for the region.

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the bond measure or its proposed college facility projects.
